title: Quadratic endomorphism expressions preserve ideal congruence
statement: Let C be a commutative ring, M an additive commutative group with a C-module structure, J an ideal of C, a,b,d ∈ End_C(M), and s,r,u,v ∈ C. Suppose (a−b)y ∈ J • ⊤ for every y, s−r ∈ J and u−v ∈ J. Then ((a*a−s•a+u•d)−(b*b−r•b+v•d))y ∈ J • ⊤ for every y. Multiplication is composition of endomorphisms; no commutation hypothesis on a,b,d is imposed.
lean_statement: ∀ {C M : Type} [CommRing C] [AddCommGroup M] [Module C M] (J : Ideal C) (a b d : Module.End C M) (s r u v : C), (∀ y : M, (a - b) y ∈ J • (⊤ : Submodule C M)) → s - r ∈ J → u - v ∈ J → ∀ y : M, ((a * a - s • a + u • d) - (b * b - r • b + v • d)) y ∈ J • (⊤ : Submodule C M)
